title: Sealed RARE Blue LA Dodgers Prime Hydration Drink 16.9 FL OZ Limited Edition
descriptionText:
Go Dodgers!

This limited edition blue LA Dodgers Prime hydration drink is a rare find for any collector or fan of energy drinks. The 16.9 FL OZ container is perfect for on-the-go use and features the iconic Dodgers logo. 

Made in the United States, this original and authentic energy drink is a must-have for any collector of advertising and food & beverage memorabilia. The blue color and energy drinks theme make it a unique addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this rare piece of Dodgers history.
